decisions.rationale: UASTC (lambda 1) albedo in two parts of 16 layers, joined at load, with the normals derived at load as before, looks the same in play: 0.26-0.30% of the frame over 8/255 (median), 44 dB, 50 dB blurred, fine-detail energy 0.99, tone within 0.6%, the same as the single 32-layer file reviewed first (_reviews/gate-ktx2-surfaces), which exceeded the world's 8 MiB per-file budget. Rejected there: ETC1S albedo (18-19% of the frame over 8/255, visibly softer gravel and slightly darker), ETC1S normals (25% with ETC1S albedo), UASTC normals (10.1-10.3 MB at any rate-distortion setting) and UASTC lambda 2-4 albedo (1.1-5.7%).
